title: Make a worm picker
author: Cristian Riccio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5qpg5vn

steps.title: Prepare platinum wire
steps.instruction: Cut a piece of platinum wire to a length of 8 cm.

steps.title: Secure wire in holder
steps.instruction: Insert the platinum wire into the loop holder and tighten the screw to secure it.

steps.title: Shape the wire tip
steps.instruction: Flatten the end of the platinum wire using your nails to create a spoon-like shape for collecting worms.

steps.title: Sterilize the tool
steps.instruction: Sterilize the worm picker under a flame before picking worms.
